message.content:
Use the *maxsplit* argument of `str.split()` so that it splits only at the first “=`”:

```python
temp = "hello=good="
parts = temp.split('=', 1)   # split at most once
print(parts)                 # ['hello', 'good=']
```

`split('=', 1)` tells Python to split on “=`” but stop after the first split, leaving the remainder (`"good="`) intact.
